heldRevisedRow.question: Which of these spices belongs to the same plant family as ginger?
heldRevisedRow.funFact: Common culinary ginger is Zingiber officinale.
heldRevisedRow.confidenceReason: The credited Britannica ginger-family body identifies turmeric among its economically valuable members, while separately compiled Wikipedia groups ginger and turmeric in Zingiberaceae. Both identify common ginger as Zingiber officinale; the revised stem asserts no selected-source color claim.

sources.quote: The dried thick rhizome of turmeric ( Curcuma longa )
sources.funFactQuote: Ginger is obtained from the fresh or dried rhizomes of Zingiber officinale

sources.quote: Ginger is in the family Zingiberaceae , which also includes turmeric

claims.text: Which of these spices belongs to the same plant family as ginger? Answer: Turmeric
Common culinary ginger is Zingiber officinale.
